independence_declaration.statement: I am the code-security-reviewer project agent. I authored no implementation in the reviewed scope: tools/gates/**, tools/agents/**, tools/source/**, .github/workflows/delivery-gates.yml, .claude/agents/*.md and the delivery records. I wrote only review records and evidence under docs/delivery/reviews/DG0/round-7/ and docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/code-security/round-7/. I formed this verdict without reading any other round-7 review record.

checks_run.procedure: Confirm the frozen candidate before reviewing: HEAD vs source commit, recomputed candidate ID, post-freeze commits metadata-only, manifest recomputes from its source_commit
checks_run.command: git rev-parse HEAD; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0; git diff --stat e11b5f08..HEAD; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0 --ref e11b5f08dfa8b6cbe8716964e3412e17697234aa; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0 --diff
checks_run.environment: main tree /home/user/My-owns (HEAD 29b5255, later 21be910 after other reviewers' auto-commits), node v22.22.2, git 2.43.0
checks_run.expected: Candidate ID sha256:dee0316d...cece in the working tree and at e11b5f08; commits after the freeze touch only excluded delivery metadata
checks_run.actual: Working tree and --ref e11b5f08 both give sha256:dee0316dce953eb00665cbfc452ba9da140dce70b9faa0c028af0de38626cece (79 files). --diff matches. Post-freeze commits touch only assignments/, candidates/, stages.json, reviews/DG0/round-7/ and runs/DG0/. The manifest uses mth-candidate-v2 with spec {include:[**], exclude:[trading_agent/**]}.

checks_run.command: node --test tools/gates/tests/*.test.mjs tools/agents/tests/*.test.mjs; python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/agents/tests -p 'test_*.py'
checks_run.environment: git worktree /tmp/dg0-sec7 at e11b5f08 (removed afterwards), node v22.22.2, Python 3.11.15
checks_run.expected: All tests pass; generated bytecode is ignored
checks_run.actual: node: 50 tests, 50 pass, 0 fail (exit 0). unittest: 5 tests OK (exit 0). __pycache__ shows as ignored (!!).

checks_run.procedure:
Code review of the round-7 checkInvocation changes (D-021 transcript replay, D-022 replayed prompt) plus my own reproduction: replace a reviewer's transcript with gzip('') or gzip('


'), re-hash it in meta, and validate in current and historical mode; control with an unparsable transcript
checks_run.environment: disposable fixture repositories in /tmp built by the verbatim e11b5f08 test helpers; validator from worktrees of e11b5f08 and a059b55
checks_run.expected: A run whose transcript has no init line, no CLI-replayed runner prompt and no final result is rejected (D-016, D-022), and a bound output that the transcript cannot reproduce is rejected (D-021)
checks_run.actual: Controls 1-2 behave as expected. Tests 3-7 show validateGate returning [] with an empty or newline-only transcript: a record rewritten after its run passes, a closure of High F-DG0-101 passes, and a committed and approved forgery passes --historical. rules.mjs:294 and :341 guard every transcript check with lines.length. The gap also exists at a059b55. Raised as F-DG0-132 (High, mandatory). Test 8: the replayed prompt's assignment is not cross-checked with meta, raised as F-DG0-133 (Low).

checks_run.procedure: Port my round-6 carried reproduction suite onto the e11b5f08 helpers and run it against a059b55 (round-6 candidate) and e11b5f08; wording-neutral variant for the changed write-once messages
checks_run.environment: worktrees of a059b55 and e11b5f08 in /tmp (removed afterwards); node v22.22.2; git 2.43.0
checks_run.expected: On e11b5f08 every FIXED test passes and the round-6 residual BYPASS N4/N4b (a back-dated side branch plus merge) no longer passes the gate
checks_run.actual: a059b55: 24/24 ok, including BYPASS N4/N4b (the weakness is present). e11b5f08: 22 ok. The two failures are BYPASS N4/N4b, now rejected with 'committed with 2 different contents', 'has a M event' and 'is back-dated before its parent' (the weakness is absent, which is the expected outcome, hence node exit 1). In the verbatim port, 8 tests differ only by error wording or a fixture interaction; this is explained in 03 and resolved in the neutral variant.

checks_run.environment: four worktrees in /tmp (removed afterwards); node v22.22.2; git 2.43.0
checks_run.expected: The original weaknesses reproduce on the old commits
checks_run.actual: r1 8/8, r2 16/16, r3 10/10 and r4 20/20 ok: every original BYPASS reproduces on its original commit.

checks_run.procedure: Feed PreToolUse payloads through the real per-role hook commands from tools/agents/settings/*.settings.json: protected paths, config surfaces, planted nested .git, '..', case, symlinked directory, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit, garbage payload, reviewer scope, missing git binary
checks_run.command: bash docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/code-security/round-7/07-guard-e2e.sh /tmp/dg0-sec7; the no-git probe re-run with /bin/bash and PATH holding only node
checks_run.expected: Protected or out-of-scope writes are blocked (exit 2), in-scope writes allowed (exit 0), and the guard fails closed without git
checks_run.actual: Implementer: 16 protected probes blocked (exit 2) and src/ok.ts allowed. Reviewer: its reviews/ and test-evidence/ writes allowed, and 6 other paths blocked. No git: 'write guard missing', exit 2. The first no-git attempt returned 127 because of a harness PATH error, which is annotated and superseded by 08. The Bash gap is disclosed (agent-protocol.md:78, D-020).

checks_run.procedure: Drive tools/agents/run-agent.sh with a stub claude that reads the stream-json prompt from stdin and replays it (isReplay:true) like the real CLI. Modes: honest, denied, edit, shelledit, multiedit, glob, space, outage/resume, exit3. Check each run with the candidate's checkInvocation (with and without binding). Also test argument validation, shell metacharacters in the assignment path, session uniqueness, and old (53f5d176) vs new behaviour for glob, denied, shelledit and lockfail
checks_run.expected: Honest runs bind with no errors; denied, shell-edited or foreign files are not bound or committed; the resume replays the prompt; the exit code propagates; bad arguments are rejected; no shell injection; a failed auto-commit fails the runner
checks_run.actual: honest, edit, multiedit and outage: checkInvocation []. denied and shelledit: rejected. exit3: runner exit 3 and 'did not complete successfully'. The outage run resumed once, with 2 replayed prompts. 7 bad-argument cases exit 64/66. The $(...) and backtick path is passed as data (no PWNED file). 10 runs, 0 duplicate sessions. On 53f5d176, glob committed the unrelated xy.md and denied/shelledit files were committed; on e11b5f08 neither happens, and lockfail exits 70.

checks_run.procedure: Independently check D-022 on a real CLI transcript: inspect this run's own live transcript, and run the candidate's checkInvocation on a hash-consistent snapshot of it, both for the correct role and for another role
checks_run.environment: snapshot of docs/delivery/runs/DG0/DG0-T-DG0-REV-SEC-R7-code-security-reviewer-20260928T162818Z-b9224c10/transcript.jsonl (533 lines, mid-run) in a temp dir; e11b5f08 rules.mjs
checks_run.expected: The real claude -p stream-json transcript contains a user event with isReplay:true carrying the runner prompt with run_id and session_id; the prompt check passes for the right role and fails for another role
checks_run.actual: Line 5 is type user, isReplay true, and the text starts with "You are invoked as project agent 'code-security-reviewer' for stage DG0". The only error is the missing final result, which is expected mid-run. As domain-reviewer: 'does not contain the CLI-replayed runner prompt'.

checks_run.procedure: Run every validator mode at HEAD, and run the new write-once and back-dating checks over the real repository history
checks_run.command: node tools/gates/validate.mjs --register DG0 | --pipeline | --reconcile | --stage DG0 | --stage DG0 --historical; checkWriteOnce/checkReviewRounds('.', DG0)
checks_run.expected: register, pipeline and reconcile PASS (exit 0). The gate fails (exit 1) because DG0 is REVIEWING and has no gate record. Real history has no write-once or back-dating violations.
checks_run.actual: register, pipeline and reconcile PASS, exit 0. --stage DG0 and --historical FAIL with 'gate record not found', exit 1, which is correct. checkWriteOnce returns []. checkReviewRounds reports only the not-yet-written round-7 records.

checks_run.command: grep and python checks recorded in 13-static-checks.log
checks_run.expected: Pinned actions, least privilege, full history, no secrets or CDNs; each of the 10 agents has valid frontmatter and a fail-closed guard hook identical to its settings file
checks_run.actual: Actions pinned to SHAs; permissions contents: read; fetch-depth 0; no secrets, continue-on-error or '|| true'. '* -text' in .gitattributes; no tracked .pyc. 0 secret hits (the one raw hit is my round-2 log quoting the regex). 39 transcripts with 0 hits. The only email is the t@example.com test fixture. No CDN references. All 10 agents: name ok, model inherit, matcher Write|Edit|NotebookEdit|MultiEdit, role argument ok, fail-closed tail, identical to frontmatter. Two harness mistakes in my first attempt are annotated in the log.

summary: FAIL. New High mandatory gate bypass F-DG0-132: rules.mjs:294 and :341 skip every transcript check (init, D-022 replayed prompt, final result, D-021 replay) when the transcript is valid gzip of '' or of newlines. A fabricated meta + result + empty transcript therefore passes validateGate in current and historical mode (reproduced; also present in round 6). New Low F-DG0-133: the replayed prompt's assignment is not cross-checked with meta. Re-confirmation of all 23 earlier findings: 22 CLOSED_VERIFIED, including the round-6 residual of F-DG0-115 (the back-dated merge is now rejected) and F-DG0-130/131 (fresh-clone prefreeze passes; dirty candidates fail). F-DG0-102 stays OPEN (FAIL), because the same empty-transcript gap restores its original forgery cost. D-022 was verified on a real CLI transcript. The runner, guard, CI, secrets and line-ending checks all pass.
